title: GeoEpi Research Group
text:
GEOGRAPHICAL EPIDEMIOLOGY


Disease science across scales.


GeoEpi studies the ecology, transmission, spread, and management of animal diseases using spatial epidemiology, statistical and mathematical modeling, bioinformatics, simulation, and computational science.


Explore selected research ↗ About GeoEpi






FOUR CONNECTED PERSPECTIVES


From molecular signals to landscapes.


GeoEpi brings complementary scientific perspectives together to understand animal disease systems.




01

Geography


Spatial structure, movement, landscape processes, and geographic variation.



02

Epidemiology


Transmission, outbreak dynamics, surveillance, and population-level disease patterns.



03

Modeling


Statistical, mathematical, simulation, and computational approaches to disease systems.



04

Ecology


Hosts, pathogens, environments, populations, and the ecological processes linking them.

title: About the GeoEpi Group
text:
ABOUT GEOEPI



GeoEpi (Geographical Epidemiology) is a research group studying the ecology, transmission, spread, and management of animal diseases. Our work connects molecular and landscape perspectives to investigate foreign, transboundary, emerging, and zoonotic animal diseases.

title: About the GeoEpi Group
text:
How we work
GeoEpi combines spatial epidemiology with statistical and mathematical modeling, bioinformatics, simulation, and computational science. Research, reusable software, and operational analysis are connected by a common emphasis on transparent, reproducible quantitative work.
The group’s public information is organized across three complementary spaces:

Research presents selected public scientific projects and outputs.
GeoEpi Hub describes current project activity and portfolio state.
GeoEpi Lab Book documents working practices for reproducible analysis.
